material_definitions: The study investigates LISICON materials Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1).
X-ray powder diffraction analysis revealed that these samples were phase pure.
Li4GeO4 is a LISICON without partial lithium occupancy.
Impedance measurements for conductors without partial lithium occupancy were performed between 90 °C and 150 °C.
